name: duplicate-delivery-idempotency
description: At-least-once delivery (documented for FUB: retries up to 5×/8h, plus slow-but-successful handlers that time out at 10s and get retried). The same webhook eventId is delivered twice. The engine must process it once: one person.created, one run — the duplicate is idempotently absorbed (webhook-inbox dedup on eventId, and plan()'s idempotency key as the backstop).

expected.notes: Identical eventId delivered twice → exactly one person.created and one run; the duplicate is absorbed. (The second delivery also sees an identical row → empty diff → no state_changed regardless.)
